svg.title: Inventory, integrity, attestation
svg.desc: Three controls. Inventory is Software SBOM plus ML-BOM plus AIBOM. Integrity is OpenSSF model-signing or Cosign plus KitOps on the pack. Attestation is SLSA or in-toto build provenance. Same system, different jobs and tools.

text.font-family: Comic Sans MS, Chalkboard SE, Segoe Print, cursive

svg.text: Same system. Three jobs. Three tools.

text.font-family: Comic Sans MS, Chalkboard SE, Segoe Print, cursive

svg.text: BOM answers what. Signature answers untampered. Attestation answers how it was built.
